BiblicalUsage: Baale-judah is the name David gives for Kirjath-jearim when he goes to bring up the ark of God — the city of Baale in Judah, where the ark had rested in the house of Abinadab. David went there with thirty thousand chosen men, and the ark began its journey home.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the day David went to Baale-judah to fetch the ark is one of the great days of the Bible, because the presence of God was coming home to his people.
